public.prompt: Read each supplied implementation. Decide whether it meets the approved total budget of 3 requests, uses standard SDK retries without repeating the call at application level, and reports success or terminal/exhausted failure with Code, Message and optional RequestId safely. The setup/call/report helpers and imports are supplied. Every snippet is a separate implementation.

items.text:
```text
APPROVED_ATTEMPTS = 3
client = supplied_client_setup(Config(retries={"mode": "standard", "total_max_attempts": APPROVED_ATTEMPTS}))
try:
    result = supplied_ready_call(client)  # one application-level invocation
except ClientError as error:
    code = error.response["Error"]["Code"]
    message = error.response["Error"]["Message"]
    request_id = error.response.get("ResponseMetadata", {}).get("RequestId")
    report_failure(code, message, request_id)
else:
    report_success(result)
# SDK handles eligible retries and backoff; terminal/exhausted errors are reported.
```

i1.message: The total budget includes the initial request; the call occurs once at application level, and both success and failure paths report outcomes with safe optional metadata access.

i3.message: Direct indexing of optional RequestId can raise another exception when it is absent, instead of reporting the original failure.

i4.message: An unlimited wrapper repeats terminal failures; SDK retries cover selected transient or throttling errors, not every failed call.

correct.message: All three requirements matter: bounded SDK attempts, one supplied call, and useful final reporting.

incorrect.message: Do not accept a snippet that meets only the attempt budget or only the reporting requirement.

hints: Separate application-level calls from SDK requests, and consider an error response without metadata.
